_comment: Expectations the app link diagnose (scripts/app_links/diagnose.py) cannot read from the build config. Everything else (hosts, bundle id, intent filters, upload-key fingerprints) is read from the repo at run time.
apple_team_id_source: Apple Distribution: Botiverse, Inc. (XDAPXFY8FZ), change-logs/1.9.1/release-receipt.md. CI reads the real value from the secret SLOCK_IOS_APPLE_TEAM_ID, which this public workflow does not use; the latest-build check compares it with the shipped IPA's application-identifier.

android_extra_fingerprints.source: Not in this repo (Play holds the key). Taken from the served assetlinks.json on 2026-11-18; Play Console > Setup > App signing shows it. The two upload/legacy keys come from scripts/verify_android_apk_with_rotation.sh.
